title: FDP-1: Food Data Provenance Declaration
description:
FDP-1 is a minimal, RFC-style specification for declaring the provenance of a nutrient value (seven fields, including a coded nutrient identity) and the validation status of any score computed from such values (five fields, including a weakest-link provenance rule). It does not specify how to score food; it wraps any existing scoring system (Nutri-Score, Health Star Rating, Nutri-Grade, Food Compass, or a proprietary score) without modification.

Provenance grades run A (analytical) to D (imputed/literature); a score's grade is that of its lowest-graded input (the weakest-link rule). Unknown values are declared OPEN and never silently imputed; values or fields known absent or not applicable are NONE. nutrient_ref names which nutrient a value is for (an INFOODS tagname, USDA FDC nutrient number, or CDNO term); source_ref names where the number came from.

This record archives the specification together with a dependency-free reference validator and a worked two-host iron example. A fuller reference implementation (a Python package) and the MASTER_CROSSWALK.tsv nutrient-to-metabolite join live at github.com/murffious/biology_as_code. Apache-2.0, with a patent non-assertion covenant (see PATENTS.md). Status: Draft / Request for Comments.
